method: OSM entrance/gate nodes within 15 m of NYC Parks property outline; proximity only, no confirmed public access
limitations: An OSM entrance or gate tag does not establish public access or opening hours.
A missing tag does not establish that an entrance does not exist.
A gate within 15 m of two property outlines may be assigned to both; geometries and OSM tags can be stale.
Existing network proxy edges are not entrance counts. The accessibility baseline is unchanged by this desk audit.
